chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man between whom and a woman there was immorality, can he marry her daughter? He said: If it was from a kiss or something similar, let him marry her daughter; and if it was copulation, let him not marry her daughter, and let him marry her (the mother) if he wishes.
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry his mistress's daughter if they had an illicit relationship?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a nuanced distinction in marital eligibility based on the degree of intimacy, reflecting the Shia juristic principle that minor acts (like kissing) do not create the same impediment as full consummation. It highlights the flexibility in family structures, allowing a man to marry the mother if he cannot marry the daughter, thereby preserving social stability while maintaining moral boundaries regarding lineage and intimacy.
